question: For phenol adsorption on CGFS-AFAC-800, what intercept C and rate constant Kid does the intraparticle-diffusion model give for part II?
rendered:
The intraparticle-diffusion model fitting results for the adsorption process of phenol by CGFSAFAC-800 are shown in Figure 8(b). Table 4 lists the relevant kinetic parameters. 

For part II, Kid (mg·g−1·min−1) = 13.16, C (mg·g−1) = 0.01.
